encoding_notes: Live Wiley guide 403-blocked and archive.org unreachable via fetch tool; values encoded from WebSearch extraction of the Wiley Author Guidelines + Paperpile/Citationsy reference-style databases (secondary sources). Confidence medium on values; null where unverified.
Case reports are directed to the daughter journal 'JCSM Clinical Reports', so case_report/case_series were omitted from the main journal's accepted types.
Only Original Articles have explicitly verified word/figure/reference limits; Reviews and Editorials are accepted types but their per-type limits were not verified (nulled).

SCHEMA GAP: guide states Original Articles 'may include up to 8 figures ... and/or tables' — this reads as a COMBINED cap of 8 figures-and/or-tables, not 8 of each. Schema has no combined cap, so figures_max=8 and tables_max=8 each encode the same ceiling; a figures+tables sum >8 will not be caught.
Original Article figures also limited to 'max of 6 sub-sections per figure' — no schema slot for sub-panel limit.

Reference style labeled 'Vancouver/numbered' by citation databases with sequential SUPERSCRIPT in-text numbers and abbreviated journal names; formal AMA overlap is possible (AMA also uses superscript + abbreviations). include_doi set false because the reference style guide does not explicitly require DOI (unstated).
Peer review reported as single-blind, so double_blind=false and no body/metadata scrubbing.

Font, size, line spacing, margins, page size, alignment, line numbers, running head, figure formats/DPI, keyword count, running-title/title length caps, ORCID/cover-letter requirements were not stated in verified sources and are null.

title_page.elements lists only the near-certain minimum (title/authors/affiliations/corresponding author); the guide names 'Title page' as a required section but the verified sources did not enumerate its full contents.
[schema-required default] figures.legends_location defaulted to 'in_text' (guide silent; legends left where authored).
